LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_CannotLaunchDisconnected: not connected to the island heart
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_CannotLaunchNoThrusters: no unblocked qi thrusters or wind sails
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_ConfirmGravEngineLaunch: Are you sure you want to cast off?\n\nYour current map, and everything that is not on cloud rock, will be lost: the island does not come back for what it leaves behind. Build a sky stake to keep this map from being destroyed.
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_PeopleWillBeLeftBehind: The following people will stay on the ground
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_AnimalsWillBeLeftBehind: The following will stay on the ground
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_PawnsKidnappedOnGravship: The following people and animals from another faction will be carried off with the island. Their faction will not forgive it
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_BuildingsWillBeLeftBehind: The following buildings are not fully on cloud rock and will stay on the ground
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_SubstructureWillBeLeftBeh: Some cloud rock is badly placed and will stay on the ground
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_NamePlayerGravshipMessage: {0} has high hopes for the new island and wants to christen it with a good name. What shall the island be called?
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_PlayerGravshipGainsName: The island is now known as {0}.
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_OrbitalWarning_Gravship:
Prepare your island for the high sky:
- Close the walls with cloud rock or jade, which hold the air.
- Cover the settlement with a celestial dome formation.
- Plant breath formations where people sleep and work.
- Cultivators resist the void by realm; the rest need the dome.
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_CommandLaunchGravshipDesc: Choose a cultivator or colonist to steer the island. Everything on cloud rock will travel to a new map. Your current map will be abandoned if you do not have a sky stake.
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_ConfirmLandGravshipDesc: Land the island at the chosen mooring.
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_AbortLandGravshipDesc: Cancel the landing on this map and let the island drift down nearby on the world map. Useful if you cannot find a place to moor.\n\nWarning: this raises the chance of a mishap.
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_AbortLandConfirmation: Cancelling will let the island drift down in a random place nearby on the world map. That raises the chance of a mishap.\n\nAre you sure?
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_GravshipLandingMarkerNotP: You must choose a mooring for the island.
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_CommandShowSubstructureOv: Shows valid cloud rock in blue and invalid cloud rock in red.
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_MessageMustBePlacedOnSubs: Must be placed on cloud rock.
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_MessageMustBePlacedInRang: Must be placed within reach of the island heart or a gravity core mount.
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_MessageCannotPlaceOverSub: Cannot be placed on cloud rock.
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_MessageMustBePlacedInRang: Must be placed within reach of the island heart.
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_MessageConfirmLandingArea: Confirm the island's mooring to continue.
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_DesignatorRemoveFoundatio: Remove bridges or cloud rock to reveal the terrain underneath.
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_StatsReport_GravshipRange: How much further this building lets the island sail over the world map.
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_StatsReport_GravshipFuelS: How much this building reduces the spirit stones the island needs to travel.
LanguageData.CVG_IslandText_StatsReport_GravEngineFue: A multiplier on how many spirit stones the island needs to travel.
